questions.q: What typically happens in a visual that combines two tables with no relationship between them?
options: Every row shows the same, incorrect grand total instead of a correctly split value
Power BI shows a clear error message and refuses to render
Power BI creates a temporary relationship automatically for that visual only
The visual works correctly regardless
questions.explain: Without a relationship, Power BI can't split totals by the other table's values — it silently shows the repeated grand total instead of failing loudly.

questions.q: What does Power BI's autodetect feature do?
options: Automatically creates relationships between tables when it finds a strong column-name match on load
Automatically renames mismatched columns to match
Deletes relationships that appear unused
Converts all relationships to many-to-many
questions.explain: Autodetect runs when you load multiple tables and creates relationships automatically when it's confident about a match — you can also trigger it manually from Manage relationships.

questions.q: Where do you go to manually create a new relationship?
options: Modeling ribbon → Manage relationships → New
File → Options and settings
The Filters pane
Home ribbon → Get data
questions.explain: Manage relationships (on the Modeling ribbon) has a New button that opens the Create relationship dialog, where you pick the two tables and columns.

questions.q: What does the error "One of the columns must have unique values" mean?
options: At least one side of the relationship needs a column with no duplicate values
Both tables must be completely identical
The relationship type must be many-to-many
The column names must match exactly
questions.explain: Every relationship requires at least one side to have a distinct, unique list of key values — a fundamental requirement, not something specific to any one relationship.

questions.q: Besides Manage relationships, where else can you edit an existing relationship?
options: The Properties pane in Model view, or by double-clicking the relationship line
Only through the Advanced Editor in Power Query
Relationships can't be edited once created — only deleted and recreated
Only from the Filters pane
questions.explain: Relationships can be edited from several places: Manage relationships, the Properties pane in Model view, or by double-clicking the line connecting two tables.
